description:
What exactly is the faith of Jesus? Find the answer to this question and many more with Jason Bradley, John Lomacang, Daniel Perrin, and Yvonne Shelton.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. What is the faith of Jesus? 

2. Does the Bible say anything about asking for donations from a politician? 

3. The Bible says to eat fruit, nuts, seeds, and green herbs. Is it safe to eat mushrooms since they are a fungus? 

4. What does the beast that comes out of the earth represent?  

5. Is it ok to work late Saturday afternoon?  

6. Is there any significance in Mary referring to Jesus as “Rabboni” in John 20:16? 

7. Can you clarify when Jesus died? If Jesus spent 3 days in the grave, the same amount of time Jonah spent in the belly of the fish, Good Friday doesn't add up. 

8. Can you please explain Romans 14? Especially verses 5, 6, and 14. 

9. Why did Jesus cry on the cross "Father, why have you forsaken me?" 

10. Matthew 10:28 says we must not fear those who can kill the soul, but we should fear him who can kill both soul and body. This seems to imply two entities in our bodies (the soul and the body). How do we reconcile the biblical teachings that the body is a soul (one entity) and is not separate from the soul? Please explain. 

11. Can you please explain Luke 16:6-8? This sounds like Jesus was condoning dishonesty. I'm sure this isn't the case but I would like to understand what it means. 

12. How do we submit and let God take control of our life?
